name: 74114 · Tulsa, OK
findings: ZIP 74114 (Tulsa) has 124 nonprofit organizations. 41 of them (33%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 34 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (32% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 74114 (Tulsa) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
